messages:
ravi: Quick update — did a focused calibration run for the new 7B-longctx-v2 with act-norm/activation-handoff tweaks. 32k token eval (news+chat mix). Compared fp16 baseline, AWQ int8, GPTQ-4, and an FP8-actscale simulation.

marta: Nice. Top-line numbers?

ravi: Pasting concise table from the run artifacts:

```
Model            PPL    RougeL_avg   AvgLat(ms)
fp16-baseline    12.3   42.7         220
awq-int8         12.9   41.5         110
gptq-4bit        13.8   40.2         95
fp8-actscale     12.6   42.1         100
```

ravi: Notes — FP8-actscale keeps most quality (0.6pt RougeL hit) while halving latency vs fp16. AWQ-int8 faster but shows a consistent ~1.2pt drop; GPTQ-4bit has largest degradation.

kevin: Any behavior vs context position? e.g., KV cache warmup / handoff artifacts?

ravi: Yes — AWQ exhibited a drifty tail after ~16K tokens on a subset (~15% of eval cases). Per-run logs show output token entropy spikes and occasional repetition. FP8-actscale and fp16 didn't show that. We traced to per-layer activation scale factors hitting runtime clipping thresholds leading to KV mismatch across shards. Quick log excerpt:

```
[2025-11-02T14:12:31Z] layer-21 act_scale=0.0032 clipped->0.0005
[2025-11-02T14:12:31Z] kv-shard-2 mismatch_seq=16384 diff=0.12
[2025-11-02T14:12:32Z] repeat-detection threshold exceeded, emitted token repeat at pos=16390
```

marta: Did you try prefix warmup or kv prefetching?

ravi: Yeah — two quick config experiments: baseline had no warmup; warmup=4k + kv_prefetch=true significantly reduced AWQ tail issues (drop in problematic cases from 15% -> ~3%). So operationally we can avoid regressions by recommending a small prefix warmup and kv_prefetch for AWQ deployments on long contexts.

ravi: Example runtime snippet we used for the reconciled profile:

```
serve_config:
  model: 7b-longctx-v2
  quant: awq-int8   # runtime profile
  kv_prefetch: true
  kv_warmup_tokens: 4096
  per_layer_act_clip: auto
  batch_size: 4
```

kevin: Good — can you attach the artifact ids? I want to plot per-layer scale histograms and share with model-onboarding.

ravi: Uploaded main artifacts (bench+logs+histograms) to CI run 4821. Links in the job output. Short link: https://ci.redwood/4821/artifacts (contains per-layer CSVs).

deploy-bot: CI job 4821 finished — artifacts uploaded at https://ci.redwood/4821/artifacts :white_check_mark:

marta: solid. Next steps: add warmup flag to awq default profile and add a quick note in the onboarding checklist about kv_prefetch for longctx. I'll open a tiny PR. :+1:
